$comment: Inputs to educateos.io/pricing (SCHO-362). cost-to-run.mjs computes every figure on the page from this file, and build.mjs stamps them into each <... data-cost="key"> element; build.mjs --check fails if the page is stale. Method, raw measurements and the worked calculation: docs/educateos/cost-to-run.md. Change a price or an assumption here, then run node sites/educateos-io/build.mjs.

prices.$comment: Cloudflare's published Workers Paid list prices in USD, read live on the date in `checked`. Each `source` is the page they come from.

assumptions.$comment: Activity per person. `measured` values come from the live demo districts in the window above; the rest are assumptions we chose, stated on the page.

cpuMsPerRequest.note: router plus district Worker, 2.7 ms mean, rounded up

rowsReadPerRequest.note: Northfield, 2026-10-27 to 10-31: 89 on average, 230 on the busiest day, rounded up

rowsWrittenPerRequest.note: Northfield, 2026-10-27 to 10-31: 0.95 on average, 3.5 on the busiest day, rounded up

cronRunsPerMonth.note: hourly notification sweep plus the weekly digest, from the Worker's Cron Triggers

sweepRowsReadPerStudent.note: 1,400 to 2,300 in the demo districts; about 4,900 in Northfield; rises with roster size

sweepRowsWrittenPerStudent.note: 15 to 18 in all five demo districts

storageMbPerStudent.note: 0.5 to 0.9 MB per rostered student in the demo districts, rounded up

durableObjectGb.note: duration is billed on 128 MB per object
